data_description.quiet_start: No spoken announcements during quiet hours. Push is still sent unless the option below is on.
data_description.keep_done: Off = a task disappears once done (it stays in the logbook). Recurring tasks always stay. Can be changed per task and per rule.
data_description.notify_targets: Mobile app (with buttons) or any other notifier: Telegram, e-mail, SMS (text only).
data_description.quiet_push: On = nothing is sent at night; a reminder that falls into the quiet hours waits until they end.
data_description.notify_data: Advanced. Added to every notification of the HA app, e.g. car_ui: true (Android Auto), priority: high with ttl: 0 (deliver immediately), notification_icon, color, channel. Can be overridden per rule and per task.

summary.name: Summary
summary.description: Text of the task. Templates allowed, e.g. "Window open, {{ states('sensor.outside') }}°C outside" (recalculated at each reminder).

start.name: Start
start.description: When reminders start: datetime, date or 'now'. Empty = note.

interval.name: Interval (min)
interval.description: Repeat every N minutes until handled. 0 = once.

repeat.name: Repeat
repeat.description: After done, task returns at the next date.

tts.name: Spoken
tts.description: Speak on the tablet when someone is home.

phones.name: Phones
phones.description: Which phones get the push (empty = none; omitted = all configured).

max_reminders.name: At most times
max_reminders.description: Stop reminding after this many reminders.

keep_done.name: Keep after done
keep_done.description: Keep the task in Done (default: integration option).

done_message.name: Message when resolved
done_message.description: Sent when the task closes itself (close_by_key / rule). Templates allowed.

notify_data.name: Notification data
notify_data.description: Extra data for the HA app notification (icon, Android Auto, priority…).

dismiss.name: Dismiss
dismiss.description: Drops the task ("won't do"). A recurring task only skips this date; use Delete to remove it.

close_by_key.name: Close by key
close_by_key.description: Closes the open task with this key.

delete.name: Delete
delete.description: Removes a task for good, also a recurring one.

update.name: Update
update.description: Changes a task. Only the fields you send are changed; an empty value clears the field.

start.name: Due
start.description: New due time: date and time, or a date only. Empty = a note without reminders.

interval.name: Interval (min)
interval.description: Repeat every N minutes until handled. 0 = once.

phones.name: Channels
phones.description: Where to send the notification (empty list = nowhere; null = all configured).

speakers.name: Speakers
speakers.description: Where to speak (empty list = nowhere; null = all configured).

max_reminders.name: At most times
max_reminders.description: Stop reminding after this many reminders (empty = no limit).

remind_until.name: Remind until
remind_until.description: Stop reminding after this time (empty = no limit).

keep_done.name: Keep after done
keep_done.description: Keep the task in Done (null = integration option).

notify_data.name: Notification data
notify_data.description: Extra data for the HA app notification (icon, Android Auto, priority…).

trigger.title: New rule — when?
trigger.description: A task is added automatically when the entity meets the condition.

data_description.summary: E.g. "Unload the dishwasher". You can add {state} (current value with unit) and {name} (device name), e.g. "Humidity {state}, air the bathroom". For calendars the event names are appended (or put {event} where you want them).

data_description.days_before: 1 = the day before, 0 = on the day.

data.auto_close: Close the task when the condition ends
data.keep_done: Keep on the list after done

data_description.auto_close: For calendars: after the event day.
data_description.done_message: Sent to the same targets when the task closes itself, e.g. "Garage door closed ✅". {state} and {name} work here too. Empty = nothing.
data_description.tts_message: What is said aloud instead of the task text, e.g. "The dishwasher is done, please open it." {state} and {name} work here too (for calendars: {event}). Empty = the task text.
data_description.notify_data: Advanced. Extra data for the HA app notification of this rule, e.g. car_ui: true, priority: high.

not_loaded.message: The Remindo integration is not loaded

invalid_start.message: Unknown start format: {start}. Use now, a date (2026-12-01) or a date with time (2026-12-01T18:00).

repeat_needs_start.message: A recurring task needs a start date
